title: Looking for Advice on Growing an Open-Source Cybersecurity Project
description: This content describes an open-source cybersecurity project called Vader-Pro-VDR, which is an AI-assisted vulnerability detection and remediation platform. The project includes a Go-based endpoint agent for system inventory collection and a Python FastAPI backend for processing and storing telemetry data. It features secure, encrypted data transmission and a modular API design. The post is a request for advice on growing the project and attracting contributors, not a report of a security vulnerability or threat.

aiSummary: Vader-Pro-VDR is a lightweight, distributed endpoint telemetry and asset management platform designed with a zero-trust architecture. It collects detailed system and software inventory data across multiple operating systems using a Go agent, encrypts the data locally with AES-256-GCM, and securely transmits it to a Python FastAPI backend hosted on AWS. The backend decrypts and stores telemetry data in a SQLite database for analysis. The project aims to continuously identify vulnerable software and configurations, correlate findings with CVE intelligence, and eventually automate remediation workflows. The current content is a community outreach post seeking advice on open-source project growth and contributor engagement, not a disclosure of a security vulnerability or exploit.
aiImpact: No direct security impact or vulnerability is described. The content is a project announcement and request for community advice. There is no indication of a security flaw, exploit, or active threat associated with the project as presented.
